```

```

chris-ops: kvstore (redis-cluster) had a brief latency spike at 15:22 — I see a few timed out writes. Could be causing double-count attempts in aggregator fallback.

maria-cs: advise placing a hold on auto-notifications to customers. I can send a calm status update after we confirm mitigation.

sam-eng: smoke OK, p95 latency 120ms, no errors.

chris-ops: throttle applied 15:26Z, target reduction ~60% replays. monitoring queues.

alex.billing: preliminary corrected delta shows cust-A +4.2k, cust-B +2.8k, cust-C +1.1k (after dedupe). previous view showed +37k total. So large part was duplicate/replay.
maria-cs: ok that's better. I'll delay notifications and prep a message: "we detected anomalous usage spikes due to an emitter replay; we're rolling back duplicates and reviewing billing. No charge adjustments applied yet."

maria-cs: drafting message for affected customers; will wait for final recon result before sending.

incident-lead: next steps: create postmortem ticket, owners: sam-eng (reconciliation and dedupe defaults), chris-ops (kvstore ops and circuit-breaker), alex.billing (billing reconciliation script improvements), maria-cs (customer comms playbook). target postmortem draft by 2025-11-08.
